duplicate_metric_note: Logical bytes count every path; distinct-range bytes exclude identical offset aliases. Neither predicts export savings or accounts for partially overlapping ranges.

shared_frost_audit.comparison_note: Actual current debug APK compared with previous per-enemy-frost debug APK report and no-frost PCK baseline, not a public release APK. Pack bytes do not measure frame performance or GPU memory. Non-frost PNG assets were not audited for visual usage; no raw PNG source, retired per-enemy frost scenes/textures, design or verification assets remain in PCK.
